name: Library
summary: Books you own, chapter by chapter, with the words you mark in them and summaries beside each chapter, and the jobs that add a book from a file. Its book is the Reading list's, with every field it has.

book.description: A book you want to read, are reading, or have read. One you own can hold its chapters in its folder.

at.description: Where you stopped: the chapter and its paragraph.

chapter.description: A chapter or part of a book, as the book divides it. Its text is the body.

part.description: The part it sits in, itself a chapter record.

quote.description: Words you marked in a book, with your note. It says where they are, so they can be found again.

from.description: The chapter the words are in.

block.description: The paragraph's number in the chapter.

before.description: A few words just before, to find the place again.

used_in.description: The addresses of the pieces it went into.

summary.description: A summary of a chapter, a part or a whole book, beside it, never inside it. It says who wrote it.

job.description: Work asked of an AI, with the file it needs attached: what to do in words, where it stands, and what it made. Its upload field (written by the app) lists the file's pieces in order, each with its SHA-256.

do.description: What to do, in plain words.

kind.description: A word a tool matches on, like import-book.

note.description: What happened: why it failed, or what was left out.
